cache_rule: Every remote contribution must initially be absent; cached remote trials are excluded, never relabelled as fresh
dataset_scope: Existing deterministic public worker fixture; this experiment does not establish fresh dataset acquisition
native_coordinator_window: Preserve generation, five rounds, cursor96 and three rejections; manual trials do not add autonomous cycles
order: For each offset in [4,8], for each policy in [2,3], distributed first then one-PC baseline; parent fixed until all trials finish
publication: After all comparisons, publish the first half-distributed candidate in the declared order that passes every publication gate; never publish a control candidate
quality_gates: Existing immutable NLL, factual and instruction gates for each policy; no tuning after observing trial results
